steps.title: Take the question
steps.process: The economies, years and measures in the question are read using code, and the reading is shown so the user can correct it.

people.task: Choose the use mode and the reply length
Read the economies, years and measures in the question

at_full_scale.in_this_build: One question at a time, no memory
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Conversation state carried into routing and retrieval

steps.title: Route
steps.process: The question is sent, using code, to the cheapest route that can answer it: a series title, a calculation, passages, or a person.

people.task: Ask the user to clarify a vague question
Escalate a question beyond the data

at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Governed query bank of hundreds, run on every change

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Keyword router; question read in parts and corrected by the user
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Small-model or fine-tuned classifier with monitored routing accuracy; catalogue of measures kept by a named team

steps.title: Fetch evidence
steps.process: Passages the use mode does not allow are removed, the matching passages are found, and the figures are calculated from the data, all using code.

people.task: Keep only the passages the use mode allows
Find the passages that match the question

at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Library of governed model classes and a semantic layer
Hybrid search over a vector index with reranking under a time limit
Nearest measure by meaning, stated openly

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Two editions, each stored in full
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Every edition kept, storing only the values that changed, as ALFRED and the UK Real-Time Data archive do

steps.title: Assemble context
steps.process: The template part is filled using code with figures, comparisons and definitions, and is put in the prompt with the chosen passages.

steps.title: Generate with citations
steps.process: The explanation is the language model's output: a few sentences, each ending with the id of the passage it cites.

people.task: Answer a definition question from passages

steps.title: Check, record, escalate
steps.process: Each sentence is checked using code; the explanation is retried once or dropped, every step is recorded, and questions beyond the data are passed to a person.

people.task: Check each sentence of the explanation
Retry once, or drop the explanation
Record each step in the trace

at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Measured check error rates; analysts review dropped explanations

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Tokens and seconds per route from saved runs
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Full tracing, a token and time limit per route
